name: Smith Machine Reverse Calf Raise
steps: Stand with the bar across your upper back, feet hip-width apart and heels under the bar path.
Release the hooks, brace your trunk and shift pressure toward your heels.
Pull your toes and the fronts of your feet smoothly upward toward your shins by contracting your front shin muscles.
Lower your forefeet slowly back down to the floor under full control before starting the next repetition.
tips: Avoid bending your knees or rocking your hips backward to cheat your toes higher.
Keep both heels planted as your forefeet rise.
